concepts.summary: Official origin of an observation with agency, system, URL/record id, retrieval timestamp.
Legal/geographic authority scope; statuses do not overwrite across jurisdictions.
Mover-specific county permit/registration/license; nullable for ORDINANCE_ONLY. Not stored in provider_state_authority.
concepts.notes: Required concept in model; row presence depends on posture.

concepts.summary: CREDENTIAL_BASED vs ORDINANCE_ONLY program posture, including Monitoring vs Licensing taxonomy.
County-reported legal name, DBA, address, phone, email, website — not canonical until fail-closed link.
Public/PRA owner, officer, or dispute-contact name/title. No consumer PII / DOB.
Local Business Tax corroboration. Architectural rule: LBT != mover authority.
Additional location only with explicit branch record; SCHEMA_ONLY != observed branch.
Fleet count or VIN/tag/GVW/decal observations; schema-only fields are not company observations.
Vocabulary layers REQUIREMENT_DOCUMENTED / CURRENT_POLICY_OBSERVED / COMPLIANCE_VERIFIED must stay distinct.
concepts.notes: Observation rows themselves may be V1_OPTIONAL per county.

concepts.summary: Allegation/intake/case observation. Not a misconduct finding by itself.
Official resolution of a complaint. COMPLAINT != DISPOSITION.
Citation/notice/hearing/admin action. ENFORCEMENT_EVENT != FINAL_OUTCOME.
Explicit finality/final order when source provides it; never inferred.
NO_COMPLAINT_RECORD_RETURNED_FOR_SEARCH_WINDOW (and analogs). Optional INTERNAL only; never consumer complaint-free.
Policy boundary: do not productize criminal records or imply guilt from referral statuses.
Fail-closed versioned links among county credential, FDACS/state, canonical company, LBT secondary.
Preserve multi-jurisdiction and true conflicts with provenance; no silent overwrite.
DISCOVERED → ACQUIRED → NORMALIZED → QUALIFIED → LINKED → PUBLICATION_ELIGIBLE → PUBLISHED.
INTERNAL_ONLY / PUBLICATION_ELIGIBLE / PUBLISHED / WITHHELD; Trust Score untouched in V1.
Per-county adapter declaration of posture, interfaces, normalize/qualify/link, PII and publication defaults.
Consumer PII committed = 0; business-level regulatory fields only.
NEAR_FULL, SAMPLE, PRA_REQUIRED, SCHEMA_ONLY, INTAKE_ONLY, NO_SEPARATE_ROSTER_IDENTIFIED, REQUIREMENT_DOCUMENTED.
County evidence does not change Trust Score in V1.
Portability is designed in; multi-state county rollout is out of V1 execution.
